changelog: Build a labeled 10-20 track instrumental playlist for a livestream room or store.

en.description: Build an original livestream BGM playlist of 10 to 20 instrumental tracks for a room, store, or live-commerce shift. This livestream background music pack and store-loop music generator writes waiting, chat, product, hype, and night beds as original livestream music you own and can use commercially, then delivers a labeled playlist you can audition before going live. Use it as a playlist BGM generator for livestream BGM, live commerce BGM, store loop music, waiting room music, in-store background music, and original stream music.
